items.title: Robinhood CEO says issuers should not have veto over tokenized stocks
items.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said issuers should be involved if tokenized products change shareholder rights or company obligations, but not when they create separate instruments backed by shares.

items.title: Senate Republicans release ‘final’ Clarity Act draft as Trump accepts most ethics provisions
items.summary: President Donald Trump agreed to ethics restrictions on the bill, which would limit officials and their spouses from crypto-related dealings.
